role: Neo4j configuration constants and type definitions for multi-instance database support
detail: Defines a single configuration token constant NEO4J_INSTANCE_CONFIG used for dependency injection. Exports Neo4jInstanceName enum with four instance types: WORLD (global knowledge graph), SELF (internal state/memories), OTHER (external actors), and PKG (package/code dependency graph). Neo4jInstanceConfig interface specifies per-instance connection parameters: name, URI, user/password credentials, database name, connection pool size, and timeout in milliseconds. Neo4jModuleConfig aggregates an array of Neo4jInstanceConfig for multi-instance initialization.
